from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
for mode,name in ((ROUND_HALF_UP,'HALF_UP'),(ROUND_HALF_EVEN,'HALF_EVEN')):
    a=Decimal('2.5').quantize(Decimal('1'),rounding=mode)
    b=Decimal('0.125').quantize(Decimal('0.01'),rounding=mode)
    print(f'{name}: round(2.5)={a}  round(0.125,2)={b}')

from tinycsv import parse
cases = [
    ('', []),
    ('a', [['a']]),
    ('a,', [['a','']]),
    (',', [['','']]),
    ('""', [['']]),
    ('a,b\n\nc,d', [['a','b'],['c','d']]),
    ('"a"\r\n"b"', [['a'],['b']]),
    ('"x,y"', [['x,y']]),
    ('"he said ""no"""', [['he said "no"']]),
    ('"line1\nline2"', [['line1\nline2']]),
    ('a,"b\nc",d', [['a','b\nc','d']]),
]
bad=0
for text, want in cases:
    got = parse(text)
    ok = got == want
    bad += not ok
    print(('ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'), repr(text), '->', got, ('' if ok else f'want {want}'))
print('\nfailures:', bad)

import decimal
from decimal import Decimal
modes = ['ROUND_HALF_UP','ROUND_HALF_DOWN','ROUND_HALF_EVEN','ROUND_UP','ROUND_DOWN','ROUND_CEILING','ROUND_FLOOR','ROUND_05UP']
print(f'{"mode":18} {"2.5->":>7} {"0.125(2)->":>11}   both tests pass?')
for m in modes:
    r = getattr(decimal, m)
    a = Decimal('2.5').quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=r)
    b = Decimal('0.125').quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=r)
    ok = (a == Decimal('2')) and (b == Decimal('0.13'))
    print(f'{m:18} {str(a):>7} {str(b):>11}   {ok}')

from tinycsv import round_half_even
for v,n in [(2.5,0),(3.5,0),(-2.5,0),(2.4,0),(2.6,0),(0.125,2),(0.135,2)]:
    mine, builtin = round_half_even(v,n), round(v,n)
    print(f'{v:>7}@{n}  mine={mine:<7} round()={builtin:<7} {"" if mine==builtin else "<-- differs"}')
